fields.description: Optional. Text that is shown when a user chooses an incorrect answer or taps on the lamp icon in a quiz-style poll, 0-200 characters

fields.name: explanation_entities
fields.description: Optional. Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the explanation

fields.name: explanation_media
fields.description: Optional. Media added to the quiz explanation

fields.name: open_period
fields.description: Optional. Amount of time in seconds the poll will be active after creation

fields.name: close_date
fields.description: Optional. Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the poll will be automatically closed

fields.name: description
fields.description: Optional. Description of the poll; for polls inside the Message object only

fields.name: description_entities
fields.description: Optional. Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands, etc. that appear in the description

fields.name: media
fields.description: Optional. Media added to the poll description; for polls inside the Message object only

ChecklistTask.description: Describes a task in a checklist.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the task

fields.name: text
fields.description: Text of the task

fields.name: text_entities
fields.description: Optional. Special entities that appear in the task text

fields.name: completed_by_user
fields.description: Optional. User that completed the task; omitted if the task wasn't completed by a user

fields.name: completed_by_chat
fields.description: Optional. Chat that completed the task; omitted if the task wasn't completed by a chat

fields.name: completion_date
fields.description: Optional. Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the task was completed; 0 if the task wasn't completed

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the checklist

fields.name: title_entities
fields.description: Optional. Special entities that appear in the checklist title

fields.name: tasks
fields.description: List of tasks in the checklist

fields.name: others_can_add_tasks
fields.description: Optional. True, if users other than the creator of the list can add tasks to the list

fields.name: others_can_mark_tasks_as_done
fields.description: Optional. True, if users other than the creator of the list can mark tasks as done or not done

InputChecklistTask.description: Describes a task to add to a checklist.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the task; must be positive and unique among all task identifiers currently present in the checklist

fields.name: text
fields.description: Text of the task; 1-100 characters after entities parsing

fields.name: parse_mode
fields.description: Optional. Mode for parsing entities in the text. See formatting options for more details.

fields.name: text_entities
fields.description: Optional. List of special entities that appear in the text, which can be specified instead of parse_mode. Currently, only bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, spoiler, custom_emoji, and date_time entities are allowed.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the checklist; 1-255 characters after entities parsing

fields.name: parse_mode
fields.description: Optional. Mode for parsing entities in the title. See formatting options for more details.

fields.name: title_entities
fields.description: Optional. List of special entities that appear in the title, which can be specified instead of parse_mode. Currently, only bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, spoiler, custom_emoji, and date_time entities are allowed.

fields.name: tasks
fields.description: List of 1-30 tasks in the checklist

fields.name: others_can_add_tasks
fields.description: Optional. Pass True if other users can add tasks to the checklist

fields.name: others_can_mark_tasks_as_done
fields.description: Optional. Pass True if other users can mark tasks as done or not done in the checklist

Location.description: This object represents a point on the map.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude as defined by the sender

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude as defined by the sender

fields.name: horizontal_accuracy
fields.description: Optional. The radius of uncertainty for the location, measured in meters; 0-1500

fields.name: live_period
fields.description: Optional. Time relative to the message sending date, during which the location can be updated; in seconds. For active live locations only.

fields.name: heading
fields.description: Optional. The direction in which user is moving, in degrees; 1-360. For active live locations only.

fields.name: proximity_alert_radius
fields.description: Optional. The maximum distance for proximity alerts about approaching another chat member, in meters. For sent live locations only.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Venue location. Can't be a live location.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Name of the venue

fields.name: address
fields.description: Address of the venue

fields.name: foursquare_id
fields.description: Optional. Foursquare identifier of the venue

fields.name: foursquare_type
fields.description: Optional. Foursquare type of the venue. (For example, “arts_entertainment/default”, “arts_entertainment/aquarium” or “food/icecream”.)

fields.name: google_place_id
fields.description: Optional. Google Places identifier of the venue

fields.name: google_place_type
fields.description: Optional. Google Places type of the venue. (See supported types.)

WebAppData.description: Describes data sent from a Web App to the bot.

fields.name: data
fields.description: The data. Be aware that a bad client can send arbitrary data in this field.

fields.name: button_text
fields.description: Text of the web_app keyboard button from which the Web App was opened. Be aware that a bad client can send arbitrary data in this field.

ProximityAlertTriggered.description: This object represents the content of a service message, sent whenever a user in the chat triggers a proximity alert set by another user.

fields.name: traveler
fields.description: User that triggered the alert

fields.name: watcher
fields.description: User that set the alert

fields.name: distance
fields.description: The distance between the users

MessageAutoDeleteTimerChanged.description: This object represents a service message about a change in auto-delete timer settings.

fields.name: message_auto_delete_time
fields.description: New auto-delete time for messages in the chat; in seconds

ManagedBotCreated.description: This object contains information about the bot that was created to be managed by the current bot.

fields.name: bot
fields.description: Information about the bot. The bot's token can be fetched using the method getManagedBotToken.

ManagedBotUpdated.description: This object contains information about the creation, token update, or owner update of a bot that is managed by the current bot.

fields.name: user
fields.description: User that created the bot

fields.name: bot
fields.description: Information about the bot. Token of the bot can be fetched using the method getManagedBotToken.

BotSubscriptionUpdated.description: This object contains information about changes to a user payment subscription toward the current bot.

fields.name: user
fields.description: User who subscribed for payments toward the bot

fields.name: invoice_payload
fields.description: Bot-specified invoice payload

fields.name: state
fields.description: The new state of the subscription. Currently, it can be one of “canceled” if the user canceled the subscription, “active” if the user re-enabled a previously canceled subscription, or “failed” if payment for the subscription failed.

MessageGenerationStopped.description: This object describes an update about a user stopping message generation.

fields.name: chat
fields.description: Chat in which the message is generated

fields.name: message_thread_id
fields.description: Optional. Unique identifier of the message thread in which the message is generated

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the message draft which was stopped

PollOptionAdded.description: Describes a service message about an option added to a poll.

fields.name: poll_message
fields.description: Optional. Message containing the poll to which the option was added, if known. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

fields.name: option_persistent_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the added option

fields.name: option_text
fields.description: Option text

fields.name: option_text_entities
fields.description: Optional. Special entities that appear in the option_text

PollOptionDeleted.description: Describes a service message about an option deleted from a poll.

fields.name: poll_message
fields.description: Optional. Message containing the poll from which the option was deleted, if known. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

fields.name: option_persistent_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the deleted option

fields.name: option_text
fields.description: Option text

fields.name: option_text_entities
fields.description: Optional. Special entities that appear in the option_text

ChatBoostAdded.description: This object represents a service message about a user boosting a chat.

fields.name: boost_count
fields.description: Number of boosts added by the user

BackgroundFill.description: This object describes the way a background is filled based on the selected colors. Currently, it can be one of

BackgroundFillSolid.description: The background is filled using the selected color.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the background fill, always “solid”

fields.name: color
fields.description: The color of the background fill in the RGB24 format

BackgroundFillGradient.description: The background is a gradient fill.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the background fill, always “gradient”

fields.name: top_color
fields.description: Top color of the gradient in the RGB24 format

fields.name: bottom_color
fields.description: Bottom color of the gradient in the RGB24 format

fields.name: rotation_angle
fields.description: Clockwise rotation angle of the background fill in degrees; 0-359

BackgroundFillFreeformGradient.description: The background is a freeform gradient that rotates after every message in the chat.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the background fill, always “freeform_gradient”

fields.name: colors
fields.description: A list of the 3 or 4 base colors that are used to generate the freeform gradient in the RGB24 format

BackgroundType.description: This object describes the type of a background. Currently, it can be one of

BackgroundTypeFill.description: The background is automatically filled based on the selected colors.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the background, always “fill”

fields.name: fill
fields.description: The background fill

fields.name: dark_theme_dimming
fields.description: Dimming of the background in dark themes, as a percentage; 0-100

BackgroundTypeWallpaper.description: The background is a wallpaper in the JPEG format.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the background, always “wallpaper”

fields.name: document
fields.description: Document with the wallpaper

fields.name: dark_theme_dimming
fields.description: Dimming of the background in dark themes, as a percentage; 0-100

fields.name: is_blurred
fields.description: Optional. True, if the wallpaper is downscaled to fit in a 450x450 square and then box-blurred with radius 12

fields.name: is_moving
fields.description: Optional. True, if the background moves slightly when the device is tilted

BackgroundTypePattern.description: The background is a .PNG or .TGV (gzipped subset of SVG with MIME type “application/x-tgwallpattern”) pattern to be combined with the background fill chosen by the user.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the background, always “pattern”

fields.name: document
fields.description: Document with the pattern

fields.name: fill
fields.description: The background fill that is combined with the pattern

fields.name: intensity
fields.description: Intensity of the pattern when it is shown above the filled background; 0-100

fields.name: is_inverted
fields.description: Optional. True, if the background fill must be applied only to the pattern itself. All other pixels are black in this case. For dark themes only.

fields.name: is_moving
fields.description: Optional. True, if the background moves slightly when the device is tilted

BackgroundTypeChatTheme.description: The background is taken directly from a built-in chat theme.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the background, always “chat_theme”

fields.name: theme_name
fields.description: Name of the chat theme, which is usually an emoji

ChatBackground.description: This object represents a chat background.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of the background

ChecklistTasksDone.description: Describes a service message about checklist tasks marked as done or not done.

fields.name: checklist_message
fields.description: Optional. Message containing the checklist whose tasks were marked as done or not done. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

fields.name: marked_as_done_task_ids
fields.description: Optional. Identifiers of the tasks that were marked as done

fields.name: marked_as_not_done_task_ids
fields.description: Optional. Identifiers of the tasks that were marked as not done

ChecklistTasksAdded.description: Describes a service message about tasks added to a checklist.

fields.name: checklist_message
fields.description: Optional. Message containing the checklist to which the tasks were added. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

fields.name: tasks
fields.description: List of tasks added to the checklist

CommunityChatAdded.description: Describes a service message about a chat or a bot being added to a community.

fields.name: community
fields.description: The new community to which the chat or the bot belongs

CommunityChatJoined.description: Describes a service message about a chat being joined by a user from a community.

fields.name: community
fields.description: The community from which the chat was joined

CommunityChatRemoved.description: Describes a service message about a chat or a bot being removed from a community. Currently holds no information.

ForumTopicCreated.description: This object represents a service message about a new forum topic created in the chat.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the topic

fields.name: icon_color
fields.description: Color of the topic icon in RGB format

fields.name: icon_custom_emoji_id
fields.description: Optional. Unique identifier of the custom emoji shown as the topic icon

fields.name: is_name_implicit
fields.description: Optional. True, if the name of the topic wasn't specified explicitly by its creator and likely needs to be changed by the bot

ForumTopicClosed.description: This object represents a service message about a forum topic closed in the chat. Currently holds no information.

ForumTopicEdited.description: This object represents a service message about an edited forum topic.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Optional. New name of the topic, if it was edited

fields.name: icon_custom_emoji_id
fields.description: Optional. New identifier of the custom emoji shown as the topic icon, if it was edited; an empty string if the icon was removed

ForumTopicReopened.description: This object represents a service message about a forum topic reopened in the chat. Currently holds no information.

GeneralForumTopicHidden.description: This object represents a service message about General forum topic hidden in the chat. Currently holds no information.

GeneralForumTopicUnhidden.description: This object represents a service message about General forum topic unhidden in the chat. Currently holds no information.

SharedUser.description: This object contains information about a user that was shared with the bot using a KeyboardButtonRequestUsers button.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: Identifier of the shared user. This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so 64-bit integers or double-precision float types are safe for storing these identifiers. The bot may not have access to the user and could be unable to use this identifier, unless the user is already known to the bot by some other means.

fields.name: first_name
fields.description: Optional. First name of the user, if the name was requested by the bot

fields.name: last_name
fields.description: Optional. Last name of the user, if the name was requested by the bot

fields.name: username
fields.description: Optional. Username of the user, if the username was requested by the bot

fields.name: photo
fields.description: Optional. Available sizes of the chat photo, if the photo was requested by the bot

UsersShared.description: This object contains information about the users whose identifiers were shared with the bot using a KeyboardButtonRequestUsers button.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Identifier of the request

fields.name: users
fields.description: Information about users shared with the bot

ChatShared.description: This object contains information about a chat that was shared with the bot using a KeyboardButtonRequestChat button.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Identifier of the request

fields.name: chat_id
fields.description: Identifier of the shared chat. This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier. The bot may not have access to the chat and could be unable to use this identifier, unless the chat is already known to the bot by some other means.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Optional. Title of the chat, if the title was requested by the bot

fields.name: username
fields.description: Optional. Username of the chat, if the username was requested by the bot and available

fields.name: photo
fields.description: Optional. Available sizes of the chat photo, if the photo was requested by the bot

WriteAccessAllowed.description: This object represents a service message about a user allowing a bot to write messages after adding it to the attachment menu, launching a Web App from a link, or accepting an explicit request from a Web App sent by the method requestWriteAccess.

fields.name: from_request
fields.description: Optional. True, if the access was granted after the user accepted an explicit request from a Web App sent by the method requestWriteAccess

fields.name: web_app_name
fields.description: Optional. Name of the Web App, if the access was granted when the Web App was launched from a link

fields.name: from_attachment_menu
fields.description: Optional. True, if the access was granted when the bot was added to the attachment or side menu

VideoChatScheduled.description: This object represents a service message about a video chat scheduled in the chat.

fields.name: start_date
fields.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the video chat is supposed to be started by a chat administrator

VideoChatStarted.description: This object represents a service message about a video chat started in the chat. Currently holds no information.

VideoChatEnded.description: This object represents a service message about a video chat ended in the chat.

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Video chat duration in seconds

VideoChatParticipantsInvited.description: This object represents a service message about new members invited to a video chat.

fields.name: users
fields.description: New members that were invited to the video chat

PaidMessagePriceChanged.description: Describes a service message about a change in the price of paid messages within a chat.

fields.name: paid_message_star_count
fields.description: The new number of Telegram Stars that must be paid by non-administrator users of the supergroup chat for each sent message

DirectMessagePriceChanged.description: Describes a service message about a change in the price of direct messages sent to a channel chat.

fields.name: are_direct_messages_enabled
fields.description: True, if direct messages are enabled for the channel chat; False otherwise

fields.name: direct_message_star_count
fields.description: Optional. The new number of Telegram Stars that must be paid by users for each direct message sent to the channel. Does not apply to users who have been exempted by administrators. Defaults to 0.

SuggestedPostApproved.description: Describes a service message about the approval of a suggested post.

fields.name: suggested_post_message
fields.description: Optional. Message containing the suggested post. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Optional. Amount paid for the post

fields.name: send_date
fields.description: Date when the post will be published

SuggestedPostApprovalFailed.description: Describes a service message about the failed approval of a suggested post. Currently, only caused by insufficient user funds at the time of approval.

fields.name: suggested_post_message
fields.description: Optional. Message containing the suggested post whose approval has failed. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Expected price of the post

SuggestedPostDeclined.description: Describes a service message about the rejection of a suggested post.

fields.name: suggested_post_message
fields.description: Optional. Message containing the suggested post. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

fields.name: comment
fields.description: Optional. Comment with which the post was declined

SuggestedPostPaid.description: Describes a service message about a successful payment for a suggested post.

fields.name: suggested_post_message
fields.description: Optional. Message containing the suggested post. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency in which the payment was made. Currently, one of “XTR” for Telegram Stars or “TON” for TON grams.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Optional. The amount of the currency that was received by the channel in nanograms; for payments in TON grams only

fields.name: star_amount
fields.description: Optional. The amount of Telegram Stars that was received by the channel; for payments in Telegram Stars only

SuggestedPostRefunded.description: Describes a service message about a payment refund for a suggested post.

fields.name: suggested_post_message
fields.description: Optional. Message containing the suggested post. Note that the Message object in this field will not contain the reply_to_message field even if it itself is a reply.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Reason for the refund. Currently, one of “post_deleted” if the post was deleted within 24 hours of being posted or removed from scheduled messages without being posted, or “payment_refunded” if the payer refunded their payment.

GiveawayCreated.description: This object represents a service message about the creation of a scheduled giveaway.

fields.name: prize_star_count
fields.description: Optional. The number of Telegram Stars to be split between giveaway winners; for Telegram Star giveaways only

Giveaway.description: This object represents a message about a scheduled giveaway.

fields.name: chats
fields.description: The list of chats which the user must join to participate in the giveaway

fields.name: winners_selection_date
fields.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when winners of the giveaway will be selected

fields.name: winner_count
fields.description: The number of users which are supposed to be selected as winners of the giveaway

fields.name: only_new_members
fields.description: Optional. True, if only users who join the chats after the giveaway started should be eligible to win

fields.name: has_public_winners
fields.description: Optional. True, if the list of giveaway winners will be visible to everyone

fields.name: prize_description
fields.description: Optional. Description of additional giveaway prize

fields.name: country_codes
fields.description: Optional. A list of two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes indicating the countries from which eligible users for the giveaway must come. If empty, then all users can participate in the giveaway. Users with a phone number that was bought on Fragment can always participate in giveaways.

fields.name: prize_star_count
fields.description: Optional. The number of Telegram Stars to be split between giveaway winners; for Telegram Star giveaways only

fields.name: premium_subscription_month_count
fields.description: Optional. The number of months the Telegram Premium subscription won from the giveaway will be active for; for Telegram Premium giveaways only

GiveawayWinners.description: This object represents a message about the completion of a giveaway with public winners.

fields.name: chat
fields.description: The chat that created the giveaway

fields.name: giveaway_message_id
fields.description: Identifier of the message with the giveaway in the chat

fields.name: winners_selection_date
fields.description: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when winners of the giveaway were selected

fields.name: winner_count
fields.description: Total number of winners in the giveaway

fields.name: winners
fields.description: List of up to 100 winners of the giveaway

fields.name: additional_chat_count
fields.description: Optional. The number of other chats the user had to join in order to be eligible for the giveaway

fields.name: prize_star_count
fields.description: Optional. The number of Telegram Stars that were split between giveaway winners; for Telegram Star giveaways only

fields.name: premium_subscription_month_count
fields.description: Optional. The number of months the Telegram Premium subscription won from the giveaway will be active for; for Telegram Premium giveaways only

fields.name: unclaimed_prize_count
fields.description: Optional. Number of undistributed prizes

fields.name: only_new_members
fields.description: Optional. True, if only users who had joined the chats after the giveaway started were eligible to win

fields.name: was_refunded
fields.description: Optional. True, if the giveaway was canceled because the payment for it was refunded

fields.name: prize_description
fields.description: Optional. Description of additional giveaway prize

GiveawayCompleted.description: This object represents a service message about the completion of a giveaway without public winners.

fields.name: winner_count
fields.description: Number of winners in the giveaway

fields.name: unclaimed_prize_count
fields.description: Optional. Number of undistributed prizes

fields.name: giveaway_message
fields.description: Optional. Message with the giveaway that was completed, if it wasn't deleted

fields.name: is_star_giveaway
fields.description: Optional. True, if the giveaway is a Telegram Star giveaway. Otherwise, currently, the giveaway is a Telegram Premium giveaway.

LinkPreviewOptions.description: Describes the options used for link preview generation.

fields.name: is_disabled
fields.description: Optional. True, if the link preview is disabled

fields.name: url
fields.description: Optional. URL to use for the link preview. If empty, then the first URL found in the message text will be used.

fields.name: prefer_small_media
fields.description: Optional. True, if the media in the link preview is supposed to be shrunk; ignored if the URL isn't explicitly specified or media size change isn't supported for the preview

fields.name: prefer_large_media
fields.description: Optional. True, if the media in the link preview is supposed to be enlarged; ignored if the URL isn't explicitly specified or media size change isn't supported for the preview

fields.name: show_above_text
fields.description: Optional. True, if the link preview must be shown above the message text; otherwise, the link preview will be shown below the message text

SuggestedPostPrice.description: Describes the price of a suggested post.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Currency in which the post will be paid. Currently, must be one of “XTR” for Telegram Stars or “TON” for TON grams.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The amount of the currency that will be paid for the post in the smallest units of the currency, i.e. Telegram Stars or nanograms. Currently, price in Telegram Stars must be between 5 and 100000, and price in nanograms must be between 10000000 and 10000000000000.

SuggestedPostInfo.description: Contains information about a suggested post.

fields.name: state
fields.description: State of the suggested post. Currently, it can be one of “pending”, “approved”, “declined”.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Optional. Proposed price of the post. If the field is omitted, then the post is unpaid.

fields.name: send_date
fields.description: Optional. Proposed send date of the post. If the field is omitted, then the post can be published at any time within 30 days at the sole discretion of the user or administrator who approves it.

SuggestedPostParameters.description: Contains parameters of a post that is being suggested by the bot.

fields.name: price
fields.description: Optional. Proposed price for the post. If the field is omitted, then the post is unpaid.

fields.name: send_date
fields.description: Optional. Proposed send date of the post. If specified, then the date must be between 300 second and 2678400 seconds (30 days) in the future. If the field is omitted, then the post can be published at any time within 30 days at the sole discretion of the user who approves it.

DirectMessagesTopic.description: Describes a topic of a direct messages chat.

fields.name: topic_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the topic. This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier.

fields.name: user
fields.description: Optional. Information about the user that created the topic. Currently, it is always present.

UserProfilePhotos.description: This object represent a user's profile pictures.

fields.name: total_count
fields.description: Total number of profile pictures the target user has

fields.name: photos
fields.description: Requested profile pictures (in up to 4 sizes each)

UserProfileAudios.description: This object represents the audios displayed on a user's profile.

fields.name: total_count
fields.description: Total number of profile audios for the target user

fields.name: audios
fields.description: Requested profile audios

File.description: This object represents a file ready to be downloaded. The file can be downloaded via the link https://api.telegram.org/file/bot<token>/<file_path>. It is guaranteed that the link will be valid for at least 1 hour. When the link expires, a new one can be requested by calling getFile.

fields.name: file_id
fields.description: Identifier for this file, which can be used to download or reuse the file

fields.name: file_unique_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this file, which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.

fields.name: file_size
fields.description: Optional. File size in bytes. It can be bigger than 2^31 and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a signed 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this value.

fields.name: file_path
fields.description: Optional. File path. Use https://api.telegram.org/file/bot<token>/<file_path> to get the file.

fields.name: url
fields.description: An HTTPS URL of a Web App to be opened with additional data as specified in Initializing Web Apps

ReplyKeyboardMarkup.description: This object represents a custom keyboard with reply options (see Introduction to bots for details and examples). Not supported in channels and for messages sent on behalf of a business account.

fields.name: keyboard
fields.description: Array of button rows, each represented by an Array of KeyboardButton objects

fields.name: is_persistent
fields.description: Optional. Requests clients to always show the keyboard when the regular keyboard is hidden. Defaults to False, in which case the custom keyboard can be hidden and opened with a keyboard icon.

fields.name: resize_keyboard
fields.description: Optional. Requests clients to resize the keyboard vertically for optimal fit (e.g., make the keyboard smaller if there are just two rows of buttons). Defaults to False, in which case the custom keyboard is always of the same height as the app's standard keyboard.

fields.name: one_time_keyboard
fields.description: Optional. Requests clients to hide the keyboard as soon as it's been used. The keyboard will still be available, but clients will automatically display the usual letter-keyboard in the chat - the user can press a special button in the input field to see the custom keyboard again. Defaults to False.

fields.name: input_field_placeholder
fields.description: Optional. The placeholder to be shown in the input field when the keyboard is active; 1-64 characters

fields.name: selective
fields.description: Optional. Use this parameter if you want to show the keyboard to specific users only. Targets: 1) users that are @mentioned in the text of the Message object; 2) if the bot's message is a reply to a message in the same chat and forum topic, sender of the original message.Example: A user requests to change the bot's language, bot replies to the request with a keyboard to select the new language. Other users in the group don't see the keyboard.

fields.name: force_reply
fields.description: Optional. Pass True if the reply interface must be shown to the user, as if they had manually selected the bot's message and tapped 'Reply'

KeyboardButton.description: This object represents one button of the reply keyboard. At most one of the fields other than text, icon_custom_emoji_id, and style must be used to specify the type of the button. For simple text buttons, String can be used instead of this object to specify the button text.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Text of the button. If none of the fields other than text, icon_custom_emoji_id, and style are used, it will be sent as a message when the button is pressed.

fields.name: icon_custom_emoji_id
fields.description: Optional. Unique identifier of the custom emoji shown before the text of the button. Can only be used by bots that purchased additional usernames on Fragment or in the messages directly sent by the bot to private, group and supergroup chats if the owner of the bot has a Telegram Premium subscription.

fields.name: style
fields.description: Optional. Style of the button. Must be one of “danger” (red), “success” (green) or “primary” (blue). If omitted, then an app-specific style is used.

fields.name: request_users
fields.description: Optional. If specified, pressing the button will open a list of suitable users. Identifiers of selected users will be sent to the bot in a “users_shared” service message. Available in private chats only.

fields.name: request_chat
fields.description: Optional. If specified, pressing the button will open a list of suitable chats. Tapping on a chat will send its identifier to the bot in a “chat_shared” service message. Available in private chats only.

fields.name: request_managed_bot
fields.description: Optional. If specified, pressing the button will ask the user to create and share a bot that will be managed by the current bot. Available for bots that enabled management of other bots in the @BotFather Mini App. Available in private chats only.

fields.name: request_contact
fields.description: Optional. If True, the user's phone number will be sent as a contact when the button is pressed. Available in private chats only.

fields.name: request_location
fields.description: Optional. If True, the user's current location will be sent when the button is pressed. Available in private chats only.

fields.name: request_poll
fields.description: Optional. If specified, the user will be asked to create a poll and send it to the bot when the button is pressed. Available in private chats only.

fields.name: web_app
fields.description: Optional. If specified, the described Web App will be launched when the button is pressed. The Web App will be able to send a “web_app_data” service message. Available in private chats only.

KeyboardButtonRequestUsers.description: This object defines the criteria used to request suitable users. Information about the selected users will be shared with the bot when the corresponding button is pressed. More about requesting users »

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Signed 32-bit identifier of the request that will be received back in the UsersShared object. Must be unique within the message.

fields.name: user_is_bot
fields.description: Optional. Pass True to request bots, pass False to request regular users. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: user_is_premium
fields.description: Optional. Pass True to request premium users, pass False to request non-premium users. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: max_quantity
fields.description: Optional. The maximum number of users to be selected; 1-10. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: request_name
fields.description: Optional. Pass True to request the users' first and last names

fields.name: request_username
fields.description: Optional. Pass True to request the users' usernames

fields.name: request_photo
fields.description: Optional. Pass True to request the users' photos

KeyboardButtonRequestChat.description: This object defines the criteria used to request a suitable chat. Information about the selected chat will be shared with the bot when the corresponding button is pressed. The bot will be granted requested rights in the chat if appropriate. More about requesting chats ».

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Signed 32-bit identifier of the request, which will be received back in the ChatShared object. Must be unique within the message.

fields.name: chat_is_channel
fields.description: Pass True to request a channel chat, pass False to request a group or a supergroup chat

fields.name: chat_is_forum
fields.description: Optional. Pass True to request a forum supergroup, pass False to request a non-forum chat. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: chat_has_username
fields.description: Optional. Pass True to request a supergroup or a channel with a username, pass False to request a chat without a username. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: chat_is_created
fields.description: Optional. Pass True to request a chat owned by the user. Otherwise, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: user_administrator_rights
fields.description: Optional. A JSON-serialized object listing the required administrator rights of the user in the chat. The rights must be a superset of bot_administrator_rights. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: bot_administrator_rights
fields.description: Optional. A JSON-serialized object listing the required administrator rights of the bot in the chat. The rights must be a subset of user_administrator_rights. If not specified, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: bot_is_member
fields.description: Optional. Pass True to request a chat with the bot as a member. Otherwise, no additional restrictions are applied.

fields.name: request_title
fields.description: Optional. Pass True to request the chat's title

fields.name: request_username
fields.description: Optional. Pass True to request the chat's username

fields.name: request_photo
fields.description: Optional. Pass True to request the chat's photo

KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot.description: This object defines the parameters for the creation of a managed bot. Information about the created bot will be shared with the bot using the update managed_bot and a Message with the field managed_bot_created.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Signed 32-bit identifier of the request. Must be unique within the message.

fields.name: suggested_name
fields.description: Optional. Suggested name for the bot

fields.name: suggested_username
fields.description: Optional. Suggested username for the bot

KeyboardButtonPollType.description: This object represents type of a poll, which is allowed to be created and sent when the corresponding button is pressed.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Optional. If quiz is passed, the user will be allowed to create only polls in the quiz mode. If regular is passed, only regular polls will be allowed. Otherwise, the user will be allowed to create a poll of any type.

ReplyKeyboardRemove.description: Upon receiving a message with this object, Telegram clients will remove the current custom keyboard and display the default letter-keyboard. By default, custom keyboards are displayed until a new keyboard is sent by a bot. An exception is made for one-time keyboards that are hidden immediately after the user presses a button (see ReplyKeyboardMarkup). Not supported in channels and for messages sent on behalf of a business account.

fields.name: remove_keyboard
fields.description: Requests clients to remove the custom keyboard (user will not be able to summon this keyboard; if you want to hide the keyboard from sight but keep it accessible, use one_time_keyboard in ReplyKeyboardMarkup)

fields.name: selective
fields.description: Optional. Use this parameter if you want to remove the keyboard for specific users only. Targets: 1) users that are @mentioned in the text of the Message object; 2) if the bot's message is a reply to a message in the same chat and forum topic, sender of the original message.Example: A user votes in a poll, bot returns confirmation message in reply to the vote and removes the keyboard for that user, while still showing the keyboard with poll options to users who haven't voted yet.

InlineKeyboardMarkup.description: This object represents an inline keyboard that appears right next to the message it belongs to.

fields.name: inline_keyboard
fields.description: Array of button rows, each represented by an Array of InlineKeyboardButton objects

fields.name: force_reply
fields.description: Optional. Pass True if the reply interface must be shown to the user, as if they had manually selected the bot's message and tapped 'Reply'. The value of the field can't be changed when the inline keyboard is edited.

InlineKeyboardButton.description: This object represents one button of an inline keyboard. Exactly one of the fields other than text, icon_custom_emoji_id, and style must be used to specify the type of the button.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Label text on the button

fields.name: icon_custom_emoji_id
fields.description: Optional. Unique identifier of the custom emoji shown before the text of the button. Can only be used by bots that purchased additional usernames on Fragment or in the messages directly sent by the bot to private, group and supergroup chats if the owner of the bot has a Telegram Premium subscription.

fields.name: style
fields.description: Optional. Style of the button. Must be one of “danger” (red), “success” (green) or “primary” (blue). If omitted, then an app-specific style is used.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Optional. HTTP or tg:// URL to be opened when the button is pressed. Links tg://user?id=<user_id> can be used to mention a user by their identifier without using a username, if this is allowed by their privacy settings.

fields.name: callback_data
fields.description: Optional. Data to be sent in a callback query to the bot when the button is pressed, 1-64 bytes

fields.name: web_app
fields.description: Optional. Description of the Web App that will be launched when the user presses the button. The Web App will be able to send an arbitrary message on behalf of the user using the method answerWebAppQuery. Available only in private chats between a user and the bot. Not supported for messages sent on behalf of a business account.

fields.name: login_url
fields.description: Optional. An HTTPS URL used to automatically authorize the user. Can be used as a replacement for the Telegram Login Widget. Not supported for ephemeral messages.

fields.name: switch_inline_query
fields.description: Optional. If set, pressing the button will prompt the user to select one of their chats, open that chat and insert the bot's username and the specified inline query in the input field. May be empty, in which case just the bot's username will be inserted. Not supported for messages sent in channel direct messages chats and on behalf of a business account.

fields.name: switch_inline_query_current_chat
fields.description: Optional. If set, pressing the button will insert the bot's username and the specified inline query in the current chat's input field. May be empty, in which case only the bot's username will be inserted.This offers a quick way for the user to open your bot in inline mode in the same chat - good for selecting something from multiple options. Not supported in channels and for messages sent in channel direct messages chats and on behalf of a business account.

fields.name: switch_inline_query_chosen_chat
fields.description: Optional. If set, pressing the button will prompt the user to select one of their chats of the specified type, open that chat and insert the bot's username and the specified inline query in the input field. Not supported for messages sent in channel direct messages chats and on behalf of a business account.

fields.name: copy_text
fields.description: Optional. Description of the button that copies the specified text to the clipboard

fields.name: callback_game
fields.description: Optional. Description of the game that will be launched when the user presses the button.NOTE: This type of button must always be the first button in the first row.

fields.name: pay
fields.description: Optional. Specify True, to send a Pay button. Substrings “” and “XTR” in the buttons's text will be replaced with a Telegram Star icon.NOTE: This type of button must always be the first button in the first row and can only be used in invoice messages.

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: Optional. If set, then the button is disabled and does nothing

LoginUrl.description: This object represents a parameter of the inline keyboard button used to automatically authorize a user. It serves as a great replacement for the Telegram Login Widget when the user is coming from Telegram. All the user needs to do is tap/click a button and confirm that they want to log in:

fields.name: url
fields.description: An HTTPS URL to be opened with user authorization data added to the query string when the button is pressed. If the user refuses to provide authorization data, the original URL without information about the user will be opened. The data added is the same as described in Receiving authorization data.NOTE: You must always check the hash of the received data to verify the authentication and the integrity of the data as described in Checking authorization.

fields.name: forward_text
fields.description: Optional. New text of the button in forwarded messages

fields.name: bot_username
fields.description: Optional. Username of a bot, which will be used for user authorization; not supported in RichMessageButton. See Setting up a bot for more details. If not specified, the current bot's username will be assumed. The url's domain must be the same as the domain linked with the bot. See Linking your domain to the bot for more details.

fields.name: request_write_access
fields.description: Optional. Pass True to request the permission for your bot to send messages to the user

SwitchInlineQueryChosenChat.description: This object represents an inline button that switches the current user to inline mode in a chosen chat, with an optional default inline query.

fields.name: query
fields.description: Optional. The default inline query to be inserted in the input field. If left empty, only the bot's username will be inserted.

fields.name: allow_user_chats
fields.description: Optional. True, if private chats with users can be chosen

fields.name: allow_bot_chats
fields.description: Optional. True, if private chats with bots can be chosen

fields.name: allow_group_chats
fields.description: Optional. True, if group and supergroup chats can be chosen

fields.name: allow_channel_chats
fields.description: Optional. True, if channel chats can be chosen

CopyTextButton.description: This object represents an inline keyboard button that copies specified text to the clipboard.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The text to be copied to the clipboard; 1-256 characters

DisabledButton.description: This object represents a disabled button which does nothing. Currently holds no information.

CallbackQuery.description: This object represents an incoming callback query from a callback button in an inline keyboard. If the button that originated the query was attached to a message sent by the bot, the field message will be present. If the button was attached to a message sent via the bot (in inline mode), the field inline_message_id will be present. Exactly one of the fields data or game_short_name will be present.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this query

fields.name: from
fields.description: Sender

fields.name: message
fields.description: Optional. Message sent by the bot with the callback button that originated the query

fields.name: inline_message_id
fields.description: Optional. Identifier of the message sent via the bot in inline mode, that originated the query

fields.name: chat_instance
fields.description: Global identifier, uniquely corresponding to the chat to which the message with the callback button was sent. Useful for high scores in games.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Optional. Data associated with the callback button. Be aware that the message originated the query can contain no callback buttons with this data.

fields.name: game_short_name
fields.description: Optional. Short name of a Game to be returned, serves as the unique identifier for the game

ForceReply.description: Upon receiving a message with this object, Telegram clients will display a reply interface to the user (act as if the user has selected the bot's message and tapped 'Reply'). This can be extremely useful if you want to create user-friendly step-by-step interfaces without having to sacrifice privacy mode. Not supported in channels and for messages sent on behalf of a user account.

fields.name: force_reply
fields.description: Shows reply interface to the user, as if they had manually selected the bot's message and tapped 'Reply'

fields.name: input_field_placeholder
fields.description: Optional. The placeholder to be shown in the input field when the reply is active; 1-64 characters

fields.name: selective
fields.description: Optional. Use this parameter if you want to force reply from specific users only. Targets: 1) users that are @mentioned in the text of the Message object; 2) if the bot's message is a reply to a message in the same chat and forum topic, sender of the original message.

Community.description: Represents a community (a group of chats).

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this community. This number may have more than 32 significant bits and some programming languages may have difficulty/silent defects in interpreting it. But it has at most 52 significant bits, so a signed 64-bit integer or double-precision float type are safe for storing this identifier.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the community

ChatPhoto.description: This object represents a chat photo.

fields.name: small_file_id
fields.description: File identifier of small (160x160) chat photo. This file_id can be used only for photo download and only for as long as the photo is not changed.

fields.name: small_file_unique_id
fields.description: Unique file identifier of small (160x160) chat photo, which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.

fields.name: big_file_id
fields.description: File identifier of big (640x640) chat photo. This file_id can be used only for photo download and only for as long as the photo is not changed.

fields.name: big_file_unique_id
fields.description: Unique file identifier of big (640x640) chat photo, which is supposed to be the same over time and for different bots. Can't be used to download or reuse the file.

ChatInviteLink.description: Represents an invite link for a chat.

fields.name: invite_link
fields.description: The invite link. If the link was created by another chat administrator, then the second part of the link will be replaced with “…”.

fields.name: creator
fields.description: Creator of the link

fields.name: creates_join_request
fields.description: True, if users joining the chat via the link need to be approved by chat administrators

fields.name: is_primary
fields.description: True, if the link is primary

fields.name: is_revoked
fields.description: True, if the link is revoked

fields.name: name
fields.description: Optional. Invite link name

fields.name: expire_date
fields.description: Optional. Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the link will expire or has been expired

fields.name: member_limit
fields.description: Optional. The maximum number of users that can be members of the chat simultaneously after joining the chat via this invite link; 1-99999

fields.name: pending_join_request_count
fields.description: Optional. Number of pending join requests created using this link

fields.name: subscription_period
fields.description: Optional. The number of seconds the subscription will be active for before the next payment

fields.name: subscription_price
fields.description: Optional. The amount of Telegram Stars a user must pay initially and after each subsequent subscription period to be a member of the chat using the link

ChatAdministratorRights.description: Represents the rights of an administrator in a chat.

fields.name: is_anonymous
fields.description: True, if the user's presence in the chat is hidden

fields.name: can_manage_chat
fields.description: True, if the administrator can access the chat event log, get boost list, see hidden supergroup and channel members, report spam messages, ignore slow mode, and send messages to the chat without paying Telegram Stars. Implied by any other administrator privilege.

fields.name: can_delete_messages
fields.description: True, if the administrator can delete messages of other users

fields.name: can_manage_video_chats
fields.description: True, if the administrator can manage video chats

fields.name: can_restrict_members
fields.description: True, if the administrator can restrict, ban or unban chat members, or access supergroup statistics

fields.name: can_promote_members
fields.description: True, if the administrator can add new administrators with a subset of their own privileges or demote administrators that they have promoted, directly or indirectly (promoted by administrators that were appointed by the user)

fields.name: can_change_info
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to change the chat title, photo and other settings

fields.name: can_invite_users
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to invite new users to the chat

fields.name: can_post_stories
fields.description: True, if the administrator can post stories to the chat

fields.name: can_edit_stories
fields.description: True, if the administrator can edit stories posted by other users, post stories to the chat page, pin chat stories, and access the chat's story archive

fields.name: can_delete_stories
fields.description: True, if the administrator can delete stories posted by other users

fields.name: can_post_messages
fields.description: Optional. True, if the administrator can post messages in the channel, approve suggested posts, or access channel statistics; for channels only

fields.name: can_edit_messages
fields.description: Optional. True, if the administrator can edit messages of other users and can pin messages; for channels only

fields.name: can_pin_messages
fields.description: Optional. True, if the user is allowed to pin messages; for groups and supergroups only

fields.name: can_manage_topics
fields.description: Optional. True, if the user is allowed to create, rename, close, and reopen forum topics; for supergroups only

fields.name: can_manage_direct_messages
fields.description: Optional. True, if the administrator can manage direct messages of the channel and decline suggested posts; for channels only

fields.name: can_manage_tags
fields.description: Optional. True, if the administrator can edit the tags of regular members; for groups and supergroups only

fields.name: can_send_welcome_messages
fields.description: True, if the administrator can manage chat welcome messages or directly send them in the case of bots

ChatMemberUpdated.description: This object represents changes in the status of a chat member.

fields.name: chat
fields.description: Chat the user belongs to

fields.name: from
fields.description: Performer of the action, which resulted in the change

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date the change was done in Unix time

fields.name: old_chat_member
fields.description: Previous information about the chat member

fields.name: new_chat_member
fields.description: New information about the chat member

fields.name: invite_link
fields.description: Optional. Chat invite link, which was used by the user to join the chat; for joining by invite link events only

fields.name: via_join_request
fields.description: Optional. True, if the user joined the chat after sending a direct join request without using an invite link and being approved by an administrator

fields.name: via_chat_folder_invite_link
fields.description: Optional. True, if the user joined the chat via a chat folder invite link

ChatMember.description: This object contains information about one member of a chat. Currently, the following 6 types of chat members are supported:

ChatMemberOwner.description: Represents a chat member that owns the chat and has all administrator privileges.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The member's status in the chat, always “creator”

fields.name: user
fields.description: Information about the user

fields.name: is_anonymous
fields.description: True, if the user's presence in the chat is hidden

fields.name: custom_title
fields.description: Optional. Custom title for this user

ChatMemberAdministrator.description: Represents a chat member that has some additional privileges.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The member's status in the chat, always “administrator”

fields.name: user
fields.description: Information about the user

fields.name: can_be_edited
fields.description: True, if the bot is allowed to edit administrator privileges of that user

fields.name: is_anonymous
fields.description: True, if the user's presence in the chat is hidden

fields.name: can_manage_chat
fields.description: True, if the administrator can access the chat event log, get boost list, see hidden supergroup and channel members, report spam messages, ignore slow mode, and send messages to the chat without paying Telegram Stars. Implied by any other administrator privilege.

fields.name: can_delete_messages
fields.description: True, if the administrator can delete messages of other users

fields.name: can_manage_video_chats
fields.description: True, if the administrator can manage video chats

fields.name: can_restrict_members
fields.description: True, if the administrator can restrict, ban or unban chat members, or access supergroup statistics

fields.name: can_promote_members
fields.description: True, if the administrator can add new administrators with a subset of their own privileges or demote administrators that they have promoted, directly or indirectly (promoted by administrators that were appointed by the user)

fields.name: can_change_info
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to change the chat title, photo and other settings

fields.name: can_invite_users
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to invite new users to the chat

fields.name: can_post_stories
fields.description: True, if the administrator can post stories to the chat

fields.name: can_edit_stories
fields.description: True, if the administrator can edit stories posted by other users, post stories to the chat page, pin chat stories, and access the chat's story archive

fields.name: can_delete_stories
fields.description: True, if the administrator can delete stories posted by other users

fields.name: can_post_messages
fields.description: Optional. True, if the administrator can post messages in the channel, approve suggested posts, or access channel statistics; for channels only

fields.name: can_edit_messages
fields.description: Optional. True, if the administrator can edit messages of other users and can pin messages; for channels only

fields.name: can_pin_messages
fields.description: Optional. True, if the user is allowed to pin messages; for groups and supergroups only

fields.name: can_manage_topics
fields.description: Optional. True, if the user is allowed to create, rename, close, and reopen forum topics; for supergroups only

fields.name: can_manage_direct_messages
fields.description: Optional. True, if the administrator can manage direct messages of the channel and decline suggested posts; for channels only

fields.name: can_manage_tags
fields.description: Optional. True, if the administrator can edit the tags of regular members; for groups and supergroups only

fields.name: can_send_welcome_messages
fields.description: True, if the administrator can manage chat welcome messages or directly send them in the case of bots

fields.name: custom_title
fields.description: Optional. Custom title for this user

ChatMemberMember.description: Represents a chat member that has no additional privileges or restrictions.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The member's status in the chat, always “member”

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Optional. Tag of the member

fields.name: user
fields.description: Information about the user

fields.name: until_date
fields.description: Optional. Date when the user's subscription will expire; Unix time

ChatMemberRestricted.description: Represents a chat member that is under certain restrictions in the chat. Supergroups only.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The member's status in the chat, always “restricted”

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Optional. Tag of the member

fields.name: user
fields.description: Information about the user

fields.name: is_member
fields.description: True, if the user is a member of the chat at the moment of the request

fields.name: can_send_messages
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to send text messages, rich messages, contacts, giveaways, giveaway winners, invoices, locations and venues

fields.name: can_send_audios
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to send audios

fields.name: can_send_documents
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to send documents

fields.name: can_send_photos
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to send photos

fields.name: can_send_videos
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to send videos

fields.name: can_send_video_notes
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to send video notes

fields.name: can_send_voice_notes
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to send voice notes

fields.name: can_send_polls
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to send polls and checklists

fields.name: can_send_other_messages
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to send animations, games, stickers and use inline bots

fields.name: can_add_web_page_previews
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to add web page previews to their messages

fields.name: can_react_to_messages
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to react to messages

fields.name: can_edit_tag
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to edit their own tag

fields.name: can_change_info
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to change the chat title, photo and other settings

fields.name: can_invite_users
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to invite new users to the chat

fields.name: can_pin_messages
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to pin messages

fields.name: can_manage_topics
fields.description: True, if the user is allowed to create forum topics

fields.name: until_date
fields.description: Date when restrictions will be lifted for this user; Unix time. If 0, then the user is restricted forever.

ChatMemberLeft.description: Represents a chat member that isn't currently a member of the chat, but may join it themselves.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The member's status in the chat, always “left”

fields.name: user
fields.description: Information about the user

ChatMemberBanned.description: Represents a chat member that was banned in the chat and can't return to the chat or view chat messages.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The member's status in the chat, always “kicked”

fields.name: user
fields.description: Information about the user

fields.name: until_date
fields.description: Date when restrictions will be lifted for this user; Unix time. If 0, then the user is banned forever.

RichMessageButton.description: This object represents a button in a RichMessage. Exactly one of the fields other than text and style must be used to specify the type of the button.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Text of the button. May contain only plain text, RichTextCustomEmoji and RichTextDateTime entities.

fields.name: style
fields.description: Optional. Style of the button. Must be one of “danger”, “success”, “primary”, or “link” (the button is shown as a regular link without borders). Apps may use theme-specific colors for the button background and text based on the style. The style “link” is allowed only for callback buttons.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Optional. HTTP or tg:// URL to be opened when the button is pressed. Links tg://user?id=<user_id> can be used to mention a user by their identifier without using a username, if this is allowed by their privacy settings.

fields.name: callback_data
fields.description: Optional. Data to be sent in a callback query to the bot when the button is pressed, 1-64 bytes

fields.name: web_app
fields.description: Optional. Description of the Web App that will be launched when the user presses the button. The Web App will be able to send an arbitrary message on behalf of the user using the method answerWebAppQuery. Available only in private chats between a user and the bot. Not supported for messages sent on behalf of a business account.

fields.name: login_url
fields.description: Optional. An HTTPS URL used to automatically authorize the user. Can be used as a replacement for the Telegram Login Widget. Not supported for ephemeral messages.

fields.name: switch_inline_query
fields.description: Optional. If set, pressing the button will prompt the user to select one of their chats, open that chat and insert the bot's username and the specified inline query in the input field. May be empty, in which case just the bot's username will be inserted. Not supported for messages sent in channel direct messages chats and on behalf of a business account.

fields.name: switch_inline_query_current_chat
fields.description: Optional. If set, pressing the button will insert the bot's username and the specified inline query in the current chat's input field. May be empty, in which case only the bot's username will be inserted. Not supported in channels and for messages sent in channel direct messages chats and on behalf of a business account.

fields.name: switch_inline_query_chosen_chat
fields.description: Optional. If set, pressing the button will prompt the user to select one of their chats of the specified type, open that chat and insert the bot's username and the specified inline query in the input field. Not supported for messages sent in channel direct messages chats and on behalf of a business account.

fields.description: Optional. Deep-linking parameter for the /start message sent to the bot when a user presses the button. 1-64 characters, only A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ and - are allowed.Example: An inline bot that sends YouTube videos can ask the user to connect the bot to their YouTube account to adapt search results accordingly. To do this, it displays a 'Connect your YouTube account' button above the results, or even before showing any. The user presses the button, switches to a private chat with the bot and, in doing so, passes a start parameter that instructs the bot to return an OAuth link. Once done, the bot can offer a switch_inline button so that the user can easily return to the chat where they wanted to use the bot's inline capabilities.

fields.description: Product name, 1-32 characters

fields.description: Optional. Payment provider token, obtained via @BotFather. Pass an empty string for payments in Telegram Stars.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, see more on currencies. Pass “XTR” for payments in Telegram Stars.

fields.name: prices
fields.description: Price breakdown, a JSON-serialized list of components (e.g. product price, tax, discount, delivery cost, delivery tax, bonus, etc.). Must contain exactly one item for payments in Telegram Stars.

fields.name: max_tip_amount
fields.description: Optional. The maximum accepted amount for tips in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a maximum tip of US$ 1.45 pass max_tip_amount = 145. See the exp parameter in currencies.json, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies). Defaults to 0. Not supported for payments in Telegram Stars.

fields.name: suggested_tip_amounts
fields.description: Optional. A JSON-serialized Array of suggested amounts of tip in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). At most 4 suggested tip amounts can be specified. The suggested tip amounts must be positive, passed in a strictly increased order and must not exceed max_tip_amount.

fields.name: provider_data
fields.description: Optional. A JSON-serialized object for data about the invoice, which will be shared with the payment provider. A detailed description of the required fields should be provided by the payment provider.

fields.name: photo_url
fields.description: Optional. URL of the product photo for the invoice. Can be a photo of the goods or a marketing image for a service.

fields.name: photo_size

fields.name: photo_width
fields.description: Optional. Photo width

fields.name: photo_height

fields.name: need_name
fields.description: Optional. Pass True if you require the user's full name to complete the order. Ignored for payments in Telegram Stars.

fields.name: need_phone_number

fields.name: need_email

fields.name: send_email_to_provider
fields.description: Optional. Pass True if the user's email address should be sent to the provider. Ignored for payments in Telegram Stars.

fields.name: is_flexible

EncryptedPassportElement.description: Describes documents or other Telegram Passport elements shared with the bot by the user.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Element type. One of “personal_details”, “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card”, “internal_passport”, “address”, “utility_bill”, “bank_statement”, “rental_agreement”, “passport_registration”, “temporary_registration”, “phone_number”, “email”.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Optional. Base64-encoded encrypted Telegram Passport element data provided by the user; available only for “personal_details”, “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card”, “internal_passport” and “address” types. Can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.

fields.name: phone_number
fields.description: Optional. User's verified phone number; available only for “phone_number” type

fields.name: email
fields.description: Optional. User's verified email address; available only for “email” type

fields.name: files
fields.description: Optional. Array of encrypted files with documents provided by the user; available only for “utility_bill”, “bank_statement”, “rental_agreement”, “passport_registration” and “temporary_registration” types. Files can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.

fields.name: front_side
fields.description: Optional. Encrypted file with the front side of the document, provided by the user; available only for “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card” and “internal_passport”. The file can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.

fields.name: reverse_side
fields.description: Optional. Encrypted file with the reverse side of the document, provided by the user; available only for “driver_license” and “identity_card”. The file can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.

fields.name: selfie
fields.description: Optional. Encrypted file with the selfie of the user holding a document, provided by the user; available if requested for “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card” and “internal_passport”. The file can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.

fields.name: translation
fields.description: Optional. Array of encrypted files with translated versions of documents provided by the user; available if requested for “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card”, “internal_passport”, “utility_bill”, “bank_statement”, “rental_agreement”, “passport_registration” and “temporary_registration” types. Files can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.

fields.name: hash
fields.description: Base64-encoded element hash for using in PassportElementErrorUnspecified
